name: comp_vocal_lead_pop
description: Vocal lead pop — heavier 6:1 ratio for the consistent forward presence modern pop demands
notes: Faster 3 ms attack, tighter 80 ms release — modern pop vocals sit MUCH more compressed than rock. Use a second serial comp (4:1 with -8 dB threshold, 10/200 ms ballistics) if even heavier leveling is needed. De-esser always after.
